caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a woodworker’s marking gauge, rendered in realistic detail and set against a plain, light beige background. The gauge is primarily made of brown wood, with visible wood grain and shading indicating three-dimensionality. It has a long rectangular beam with a thicker block attached perpendicularly near one end. The block has a round, knurled knob on top and a dark metal pin or blade protruding downward and parallel to the beam near the right end, used for scribing. The beam passes through the block with a mortise and tenon join, and there is a small rectangular inset on the beam. The composition centers the tool horizontally, and no other objects or elements are present. The words "CHENU MARRENONS" in small, neat text appear to the left of the beam, suggesting a label or possible artist’s signature.
title: Tool Gauge
